parts.spokenText: Vapour pressure needs a stated temperature and unit. The source uses mPa: one millipascal equals zero point zero zero one pascals, while a pascal is one newton per square metre. Dropping the prefix changes the value by a factor of a thousand. Do not compare mmHg and mPa without a correct conversion. Spray drift can involve droplets carried away from the target; volatilisation transfers substance to the gas phase. Airborne movement is not one mechanism, and temperature, conditions and formulation matter. Page 19's persistence, mobility, non-target toxicity and use-volume factors interact; their layout is not a unique one-to-one map assigning every process to a single box.
